name: LocalModelRuntime

test_list.description: Configuration rejects wildcard and DNS authorities, credentials, query strings, and a URL whose literal loopback host or port differs from the configured endpoint.
The native ownership adapter observes only the exact listener owned by the retained root process; a different port is rejected.
A listener held by a descendant fails the root-only startup ownership check, and failed startup cleanup reaps both processes in the retained tree.

Loading validates the pinned llama.cpp endpoint; one adapter serves counting and chat while a live stream retains its lease. Clean EOF releases the lease even if the drained stream value remains alive, and aborting an acquisition waiter leaves shared slot loading owned.
A mismatched advertised model profile fails startup and the exact spawned process is observed exited afterward.
Subagent effort overrides are resolved by the existing registry and exact model allowlist without creating a parallel catalog.

An opt-in ignored Windows acceptance test starts the provenance-pinned llama.cpp process on port 18932, validates real exact prompt tokenization and structured tool-call usage under one selected lease, then closes only its owned process and observes its listener gone.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: Process supervisor implementing PlatformOps and the optional LocalEndpointOwnership capability.

inputs.name: process_spec
inputs.description: Explicit trusted server executable, arguments, working directory, and non-secret environment allowlist.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.description: Literal loopback listener address and port; non-loopback or wildcard addresses are rejected, and the API URL must encode the same literal IP and port.

inputs.name: expected_model
inputs.description: Exact configured model identifier, equal to the pinned llama.cpp model alias required in the live endpoint catalog.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: Finite readiness deadline, per-probe deadline, retry interval, process stop grace, slot lease limit, and eviction timeouts.

output_description: A bounded local-process loader and model-slot composition that publishes leases only after retained-process listener ownership and exact advertised model id are observed; it never claims authenticated endpoint identity.
